versions.content: If development error detection is enabled: TcpIp_ GetAndResetMeasurementData () shall check that the service TcpIp_ Init () was previously called. If the check fails, TcpIp_ GetAndResetMeasurementData () shall raise the development error TCPIP_E_ UNINIT .
